title: Ian Jordy Lopez Diaz
text:
Ian Jordy Lopez Diaz


Data Scientist | Physics Ph.D.


    LinkedIn      GitHub 








NoneProfessional Summary





Data Scientist with a Ph.D. in Physics (Statistical Mechanics) and strong experience applying machine learning, statistical modeling, and numerical methods to real-world industrial problems.
Currently working at AQTech Power Prognostics, developing data-driven solutions for the energy sector, including predictive modeling, signal analysis, and scalable data pipelines.
Background combines:

Advanced physics modeling (Monte Carlo, complex systems, critical phenomena)
Production-level data science (Python, ML, ETL, analytics)
Strong problem-solving and mathematical abstraction

I focus on turning complex data into actionable insights and robust predictive systems.
CVs: English | Portuguese









NoneTechnical Skills






Programming: Python, SQL, R, C/C++
Data Science: Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Statsmodels
Data Engineering: ETL Pipelines, Data Cleaning, Feature Engineering
Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite
Visualization: Matplotlib, Plotly, Seaborn
Tools: Git, Linux, Jupyter, Docker
Scientific Computing: Monte Carlo Simulations, Numerical Methods, Statistical Modeling










NoneExperience






Data Scientist – AQTech Power Prognostics (2026–Present)

Developing machine learning models for predictive maintenance and fault detection in energy systems.
Analyzing time-series data from industrial assets to extract actionable insights.
Building and maintaining data pipelines for large-scale monitoring and diagnostics.
Collaborating with engineers and domain experts to translate physical system behavior into data-driven solutions.

Data Scientist / Data Analyst – Lima Brain Technology (2022–2023)

Designed and implemented data pipelines for the ENIA (EDP) project, enabling efficient data ingestion and processing.
Performed data analysis and feature engineering to support machine learning applications in the energy domain.

Simulation Developer / Data Scientist – Lima Brain Technology (2021–2024)

Developed Monte Carlo simulations and numerical models for the ANGRA project.
Integrated physical modeling with data-driven approaches for system analysis and prediction.

NoneProjects






Intent-Aware Recommendation System

An end-to-end ML project for intent-aware product recommendation using NLP, product classification, and hybrid recommender systems.

House Prices: End-to-End Regression Case Study

A didactic end-to-end regression tutorial using the Kaggle House Prices dataset: EDA, cleaning, feature engineering, and modeling, rendered as a clean tutorial site with Quarto.

Titanic: End-to-End Classification Case Study

An end-to-end machine learning classification case study using the Kaggle Titanic dataset, covering EDA, feature engineering, model evaluation, and comparison through a Quarto tutorial website.

Iris: Multiclass Classification Case Study

A complete multiclass classification pipeline on the Kaggle Iris dataset, covering EDA, feature engineering, and model comparison, published as a Quarto tutorial website.
